scope: Publication-helper source review and AST syntax parse only. The helper was not imported or executed; no science, build, test suite, packaging, Git command, network call or numerical outcome file was read by this preparation.
source_only_checks: Limited native-prefix Git tree commands run at the discovered repository root with GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 and no Git mutation.
All S native regular blobs and Git modes are inventoried without extension/directory omissions; all local bytes must match S.
Actual strict clean build, builder source, complete pass/command logs, declared and final recorder project/generated inputs, and exactly four PDFs are bound.
Every final recorder external system input is read, but its current hash is explicitly distinguished from a contemporaneous build hash unavailable in build120.py.
P must descend from S and preserve every S native blob/mode; every native P path is included, with source inventory, build-input, actual-receipt and PDF closure cross-checks.
Metadata JSON is decoded only after its bytes match its already verified identity.
ZIP output uses sorted paths, fixed timestamps, exact P regular-file modes and ZIP_STORED; every member is streamed to EOF and verified after creation.
New exclusive attempt directories and create-exclusive outputs preserve failed attempts and partial containers; exceptions retain command/trace details.
P cannot include the final root ZIP, final parts or final output manifest; the later delivery commit adds them without an S/P self-hash cycle.

Standalone verification requires the exact four PDF paths, consistent embedded S tree/path identities, complete source/P inventory counts/bytes and complete ZIP member reads; it does not independently query Git ancestry or infer CI status.
--no-split avoids local duplicate parts. describe-parts emits only virtual range metadata with exact offsets/hashes and expressly no upload or remote-object existence claim.
peer_findings_addressed: Require exactly four PDFs also in standalone verification and retain each in required_publication_inputs.
Compare embedded author S commit, root-tree, native-tree and revision path with the package source identity.
Check embedded source and publication file/byte/readback totals.
runtime_verification: Not executed. Root owns later actual bind/pack/verify attempts and their success/failure receipts.
